title: MUST HAVE FOR ADHDers
body:
HEY GUYS! I downloaded and paid for these apps (MinimaList too) coz it’s working miracles for me in my daily routine and work routine! I use them as a combination. I use Minimalist for daily To Do tasks with a Personal List and Work list (for work). And the Habits app for my daily stuff like sleeping on time, waking up, drinking water etc. 

It was really difficult for me without external forces reminding me to do things as simple as just relaxing or calling my mom or a reminder to pay for parking (location based reminders). So difficult to focus on just one thing or a list of my tasks. Procrastination, laziness all of this comes with a lack of clarity of what a regular person with ADHD actually has to do in his/her day!

 It took me like 4 hours to set up all my daily monthly reminders which I’m using forever! This is a great app and I hope the developers see this! You’ve done a really good job, guys, thank you.
